newsitem.title: PERU: Official negotiations underway in Peru crisis.
newsitem.headline: Official negotiations underway in Peru crisis.

text.p: Official negotiations were under way on Thursday between leftist guerrillas and government representatives aimed at ending Peru's hostage crisis, Canadian ambassador Anthony Vincent told reporters.

Speaking outside the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima, Vincent said he and another three diplomats chosen by the rebels as their negotiating channel had delivered a message to Peruvian government mediator Education Minister Domingo Palermo Cabrejos.
"The process will continue in the morning," he said, without giving more details.

In statements to reporters, the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) guerrillas had earlier demanded the release of between 400 and 500 of their jailed comrades and the presence of President Alberto Fujimori for talks with them.
Vincent and three other diplomats were released Wednesday afternoon by the MRTA to begin contacts with the government.
